input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
echo "### -t 20 : ffmpeg stops when OUTPUT timeline hits 20s. Compare to real wall clock. ###"
T0=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
/usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -f avfoundation -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 -t 20 "$S/T.wav" > "$S/T.log" 2>&1
T1=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
python3 -c "print(f'   real wall clock elapsed = {$T1-$T0:.2f} s')"
printf "   samples in file        = "; /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/T.wav"
grep -o "time=[0-9:.]*" "$S/T.log" | tail -1 | sed 's/^/   ffmpeg /'
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess
d=float(subprocess.check_output(["/usr/local/bin/ffprobe","-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration","-of","csv=p=0","/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad/T.wav"]).strip())
print(f"   -> file holds {d:.2f}s of samples")
EOF
echo; echo "### input devices compiled into this ffmpeg ###"; /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -devices 2>&1 | sed -n '1,25p'
